## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
RISK-ON. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive; confirmed by broad sector positivity and cyclical participation (Industrials/Energy showing above-trend names) and major Tech leaders running strong; leadership concentrated in Tech. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology in Top 5).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology leading: MSFT (1W: +25.29% | 1M: +27.43%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +7.58% | 1M: +8.38%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials strong: ETN (1W: +15.15% | 1M: +7.58%) ABOVE TREND, BA (1W: +7.04% | 1M: +1.12%) ABOVE TREND. Energy showing lift: XOM (1W: +0.60% | 1M: +12.84%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +1.50% | 1M: +13.27%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Healthcare lagging: LLY (1W: -8.60% | 1M: -7.03%) BELOW TREND, JNJ (1W: -4.42% | 1M: -1.70%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Staples weak: MO (1W: -9.02% | 1M: -5.30%) BELOW TREND, PM (1W: -6.62% | 1M: +1.16%) TREND EXHAUSTION. Utilities and Real Estate under pressure; PLD (1W: -5.49% | 1M: -0.82%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top SP100 performers: MSFT (1W: +25.29% | 1M: +27.43%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +21.49% | 1M: +1.73%) ABOVE TREND, AMZN (1W: +20.17% | 1M: +13.62%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +16.87% | 1M: -17.46%) RECOVERY, AMD (1W: +14.07% | 1M: -6.06%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom SP100: AAPL (1W: -9.03% | 1M: -1.05%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -8.60% | 1M: -7.03%) BELOW TREND, ABBV (1W: -7.37% | 1M: -3.62%) BELOW TREND, MO (1W: -9.02% | 1M: -5.30%) BELOW TREND, MAR (1W: -9.99% | 1M: -9.10%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Staples/Healthcare.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: MSFT (1W: +25.29% | 1M: +27.43%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +21.49% | 1M: +1.73%) ABOVE TREND, AMZN (1W: +20.17% | 1M: +13.62%) ABOVE TREND; watch minor divergence pattern: several large-cap Techs (INTC, AMD, LRCX, AMAT) show 1W strength vs 1M weakness — tactical bounces, monitor for follow-through.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech is leading but internally mixed: MSFT (1W: +25.29% | 1M: +27.43%) ABOVE TREND, GOOGL (1W: +13.17% | 1M: +3.05%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: -9.03% | 1M: -1.05%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: Technology positive within the 7/11 overall; watch RECOVERY names (INTC, AMD) versus AAPL downside.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials steady-to-positive: JPM (1W: +0.06% | 1M: +5.86%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +0.82% | 1M: +3.45%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +1.48% | 1M: +7.31%) ABOVE TREND. Sector participation supports the RISK-ON call; breadth: Financials counted among the 7 positive sectors.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare under pressure overall: UNH (1W: -4.95% | 1M: -2.50%) BELOW TREND, JNJ (1W: -4.42% | 1M: -1.70%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -8.60% | 1M: -7.03%) BELOW TREND; selective bullish news exists but the sector shows weakness in 1W price action.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to leading Tech and select cyclicals while monitoring concentration risk; favor MSFT (1W: +25.29% | 1M: +27.43%) ABOVE TREND and AMZN (1W: +20.17% | 1M: +13.62%) ABOVE TREND, reduce exposure to pressured Staples/Healthcare names like AAPL (1W: -9.03% | 1M: -1.05%) BELOW TREND and LLY (1W: -8.60% | 1M: -7.03%) BELOW TREND. Style: Growth/Momentum favored but be mindful of narrow Tech leadership.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: MSFT (1W: +25.29% | 1M: +27.43%) ABOVE TREND, AMZN (1W: +20.17% | 1M: +13.62%) ABOVE TREND, ETN (1W: +15.15% | 1M: +7.58%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: AAPL (1W: -9.03% | 1M: -1.05%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -8.60% | 1M: -7.03%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Technology (sector 1W: +8.91% | 24 stocks) and Industrials (sector 1W: +2.45% | 15 stocks) given large-cap leadership and earnings/earnings-adj catalysts. BEARISH: Healthcare and Consumer Staples showing 1W weakness and headline sensitivity.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
MSFT near momentum continuation zone — monitor 1W follow-through above recent gap. AAPL downside resilience level to watch after big drop; assess whether BELOW TREND persists. ETN breakout confirmation to watch to validate Industrials strength.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
BA (+80): Boeing (1W: +7.04% | 1M: +1.12%) ABOVE TREND — FAA certification headline confirming price strength and sentiment alignment. ETN (+80): ETN (1W: +15.15% | 1M: +7.58%) ABOVE TREND — Q2 beat and raised outlook, news confirmed by sharp price advance.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
AAPL (-45): AAPL (1W: -9.03% | 1M: -1.05%) BELOW TREND — negative headlines and CEO transition chatter while price is falling, sentiment and price confirm distribution risk. WMT (-50): WMT (1W: -1.37% | 1M: +0.81%) TREND EXHAUSTION — downgrade-driven negative sentiment with mixed price action. ABBV (-50): ABBV (1W: -7.37% | 1M: -3.62%) BELOW TREND — guidance reset headlines matching price weakness.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON with Growth/Momentum style favored given Tech leadership and 7/11 sector breadth. MSFT (1W: +25.29% | 1M: +27.43%) ABOVE TREND, AMZN (1W: +20.17% | 1M: +13.62%) ABOVE TREND and ETN (1W: +15.15% | 1M: +7.58%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength. Key risk: narrow Tech concentration (Leadership: Narrow, 4/5 Tech) and tactical reversals in several large-cap Techs (INTC, AMD, LRCX) alongside headline-driven weakness in AAPL and parts of Healthcare.
